property_summary: For any order that fillOrder accepts (here authenticated via an ERC-1271 signing maker contract), the contract must record positionExpirations[uint256(hashOrder(order))] == block.timestamp + order.duration; the mutant deletes that write, so the getter stays 0 for any duration > 0.
change_summary: Delete the statement that writes positionExpirations so no expiration is recorded for filled orders.
